messages:
alex.dev: Quick heads-up — I'd like to land PR #13120 (db-metrics-backfill) before the scheduled maintenance blackout next Mon 2026-03-23 04:00 UTC. It needs approvals from @sam.eng and @priya. CI is currently red on one flaky e2e. Can we coordinate a small rebase slot or an alternative safety plan?

sam.eng: I can take a look at the code review today, will do a pass after standup. Do you have the failing test linked?

alex.dev: Thanks — pushing the CI failure here: ci-bot: build 2390001109 -> macos-e2e failed: test/session-timeout::test_session_reconnect (flaky on mac matrix). Locally the unit + integration pass. I suspect timing, not logic.

ci-bot: build 2390001109 logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/2390001109

priya: I can approve after a small comment - but only if we have a rollback plan for the backfill job. If the job runs during the blackout and something spikes we need a kill switch.

morgan-sre: Re rollback/kill switch: we can gate the backfill behind a feature flag and add a canary job with a 1% slice first. If metrics look good for 30m, promote. Also +1 on a scheduled manual hold during the actual maintenance window.

olivia.reviews: Quick note from my review: looks safe in migrations, but we should add a short smoke check after migration completes. Suggest adding: `SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'` as a quick validation.

alex.dev: Good plan. Proposed checklist for landing before blackout: 1) get approvals from @sam.eng + @priya, 2) get macos-e2e green (or a flake waiver from release leads), 3) feature-flag the backfill, 4) schedule 1% canary run for 30m, 5) smoke check + monitoring alert, 6) manual hold during blackout.

sam.eng: I'm +1 on the code. One minor nit about the retry backoff — please switch to exponential with jitter. I'll post an approval once that's in.

alex.dev: Adding that change now. Patch:```git commit -am "backfill: use exp backoff w/ jitter" && git push origin alex/13120```

ci-bot: build 2390001312 -> linux-unit passed, linux-integ passed, macos-e2e queued

alex.dev: If macos keeps flaking we can ask release leads for a targeted flake-waive to allow landing and then monitor in prod for a day. Would prefer not to, but it's an option. Thoughts @morgan-sre?

morgan-sre: Flake-waive is a last resort. If you can reproduce locally and add a small test tolerance (or mark as flaky with jira), that's better. But we can approve a canary-first landing with feature flag + monitoring and a rollback playbook.

ci-bot: build 2390001410 -> macos-e2e passed (rerun)

alex.dev: macos passed on rerun — merging window request: can someone help me grab a quick rebase slot tomorrow (2026-03-20) between 14:00-16:00 UTC? I don't want to collide with other infra changes.

sam.eng: I'm free at 14:30 UTC tomorrow, will hold a rebase slot. I'll coordinate with release rotation so we don't hit freeze.

priya: Approved. Leaving a comment about smoke check thresholds.

olivia.reviews: Approved from me as well, thanks for addressing the backoff.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout checklist created: https://deploys.internal.redwood/rollouts/13120-canary

alex.dev: Thanks everyone — will land in the rebase slot and run 1% canary. If anything odd, I'll abort and open a rollback PR. :thumbsup:
